output.reason: [ev-f0029965e392] says Istio 1.24 adds stricter validation to its internal gRPC communication with the control plane, and that this affects the third-party CA istio-csr. A CA integration that fails its handshake is an integration that breaks, so workload-failure (action required) fits.
